parse.tooLong: Keep expressions to {maximum} characters or fewer.
parse.tooManyTerms: Use at most {maximum} dice and numbers in one expression.
parse.unexpectedCharacter: “{found}” at position {position} is not part of a dice expression.
parse.unexpectedToken: “{found}” at position {position} is out of place.
parse.unexpectedEnd: The expression ends too early. Add dice or a number at the end.
parse.diceCount: Roll between {minimum} and {maximum} dice at a time (position {position}).
parse.unknownTag: “{found}” at position {position} is not a damage type, persistent or splash.
parse.conflictingTag: “{found}” at position {position} conflicts with an earlier tag on the same dice.

fortune.keptHigher: Fortune: rolled twice and kept the higher.
fortune.keptLower: Misfortune: rolled twice and kept the lower.
fortune.cancelled: Fortune and misfortune cancel out: rolled once.
